title: Two stored official Week 11 injury-report captures, parsed independently

A.kind: raw bytes captured by the nfl-readiness-register workflow

B.kind: rendered markdown transcription; NOT raw bytes

provenance.this_session_live_read_reason: the sandbox has no HTTPS egress to nfl.com; verified with curl before this run

transcription_control.method: join on (club, player) between the two independent reads; no code shared with either peer parser
transcription_control.what_it_proves: that two sessions transcribed the same publisher page to the same values. It does not make either read independent of the publisher, and a value that is wrong on the page is wrong in both.

designation_census.note: a blank Game Status is a blank cell on the official page; it is published as blank and never converted to 'available'.

reserve_list_watch.definition: players the peer session reported as simultaneously on the November 2026 Reserve/Injured list and carrying a practice row
reserve_list_watch.what_this_check_does_not_do: it does not confirm enlistment on the reserve list (a second page this session could not read); it confirms only that the practice row exists

name_collisions.handling: left as two keys; no join attempted
